answer: Make every new identity post a ferrous bond: a small, time-locked deposit refunded only after a month of verified, useful work. A crystal-clear public ledger lists each bond, its owner, and its release date, so anyone can audit who is real and who mass-produces shells. Quartz-timed checkpoints sample agents at unpredictable intervals and demand fresh proof of ongoing work; an identity that misses one forfeits its bond. A sybil farmer must fund thousands of bonds up front, wait out the lock, and keep every shell working, so the capital and upkeep dwarf what fake identities can earn.
